"Rise. Herod seeks the child."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Sleep on, it is only a dream

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your eyes open in the dark.
[TODO:ru] There is no time to wait.

ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The danger is real and near.
Do not delay.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Trust the Word
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Heaven has already spoken.
Move now.

wake.title: [TODO:ru] Wake the Mother
wake.text:
[TODO:ru] Mary sleeps with the child near.
There is no time to lose.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wake Mary and prepare to flee
[TODO:ru] Hide the child in the house

hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The angel said to leave the land.
Obey the word.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wake Mary and prepare to flee

flee.title: [TODO:ru] Out of Bethlehem
flee.text:
[TODO:ru] Moonlight falls on empty streets.
The child sleeps in Mary's arms.

warn_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Go Quietly
warn_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Your task is to save the child.
Leave at once.

main_road_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hidden Paths
main_road_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Soldiers patrol the open ways.
Keep to the shadows.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You take the small back paths.

road.title: [TODO:ru] Toward the South
road.text:
[TODO:ru] The desert stretches before you.
Egypt lies far beyond.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Turn back, the road is too far

turn_back_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Forward Only
turn_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Behind you is danger.
Ahead is safety.

rest.title: [TODO:ru] By the Oasis
rest.text:
[TODO:ru] Water glints under the rising sun.
The child must drink.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You go together or not at all.

linger_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Move On
linger_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The border is still far away.
Keep going.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You fill your skins and rise.

send_back_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Stay Together
send_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] She and the child are your charge.
Never leave them.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You take her hand and walk on.

egypt.text:

You have crossed the border.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Find a humble home and stay

court_consequence.text:

safe.text:
